title: Sector Casebook case file (data/casebook/<pack>/<type>-<n>.json)
description: Schema from Appendix D.6.8 with the extensions the generator uses. The authoritative checks, including cross-references, run in CB.validateCase (games/casebook/engine.js) during the build and in tests/casebook-tests.js.

id.description: Sector code, case type, and number, for example MFG-B-01.

edition.description: 2026 variants (Type F, file F-2.json) are excluded from badge scoring, the capstone, the skill map, and Compare until verified. They need variantOf, bridge2026, and a confidence label on every evidence card and decision, and they display the exact Section 0.1 caution.

variantOf.description: 2026 variants only: id of the 2015 case of the same type that this case varies, for example MFG-F-01.

bridge2026.description: 2026 variants only: paraphrased notes on the reported 2026 change, each with a confidence label and a clause tag from data/clause-map.json. No quoted requirement wording; no lettered Clause 5 sub-items.

confidence.description: 2026 variants only (Section 0.1): confidence label for this 2026 statement. A best estimate also needs reasoning and check.

check.description: What to confirm in the purchased standard.

tokens.description: Optional fictional names and numbers. The seed picks one option set: each token uses option (set mod its length), so give related tokens the same number of options. Seed 0000 uses the first. Use {{token}} in any text.

referenceSelection.description: Optional. The evidence shown for seed 0000, used for worked examples.

note.description: Shown instead of an evidence card when the action finds nothing of note.

variants.description: Alternative wordings with the same facts.

clause.description: One or more 2015 clause numbers from data/clause-map.json, separated by commas.

unlockedBy.description: The card appears after any one of these cards is collected.

supports.description: Id of the planted issue this card supports. Shown whenever that issue is planted.

falseFindingNote.description: Optional. Why this conforming card or red herring is conforming.

plantedPool.description: True for every planted issue (nonconformity or observation) the seed may select.

confidence.description: 2026 variants only (Section 0.1): confidence label for this 2026 statement. A best estimate also needs reasoning and check.

reasoning.description: Required when confidence is Best estimate.

check.description: Required when confidence is Best estimate: what to confirm in the standard.

confidence.description: 2026 variants only (Section 0.1): confidence label for this 2026 statement. A best estimate also needs reasoning and check.

reasoning.description: Required when confidence is Best estimate.

check.description: Required when confidence is Best estimate: what to confirm in the standard.

actionDistractors.description: Optional weak options per action element. When absent, the generic distractors in the engine are used.
